name: html-generator-kit
description: Turns a validated spec-dev-kit spec into a clickable, CDN-free, Alpine.js multi-page HTML prototype with a modern design direction sourced from the ui-ux-pro-max design-intelligence skill, headless-browser verified before finalizing. Requires ui-ux-pro-max (npm i -g ui-ux-pro-max-cli && uipro init --ai claude --global) — the skill offers to install it on first run.
